_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With only 5% of 12h windows producing a ±2-point move and zero confirmed breakers present, HOLD is the statistically honest call — not a punt, but a graded decision that wins when the coil holds.
next_move.brains_agree: No — both call Denial now, but the analyst forward-calls HOLD with medium conviction while the narrative implies an imminent UP pivot to Disbelief without naming a trigger.
next_move.confirmed_if: funding drops below 35 (risk-off, Denial→Panic) OR stablecoin_growth breaks above 60 with MVRV Z-score crossing 30 (risk-on, Denial→Disbelief)
next_move.invalidated_if: score exits the 32-38 Denial band on a sustained basis, forcing a phase reassignment
